_contract: The image layout a pod session runs inside. DEPLOYMENT facts -- where the workspace is, where the repository is checked out, which interpreter the container built, and what the provider requires of the host -- which the reusable core must not name. A session that runs a different image supplies different values; nothing here is a session's scientific choice. AUTHORIZES NOTHING.
_why_checkout_is_not_derived: It is written as a full path rather than workspace_root + '/aad' because a second image may put the checkout somewhere else entirely, and deriving it would make that layout unexpressible.
_remote_python: The interpreter every setup script builds inside the container. A fact about the image, not a repository path.
_min_cuda_version: Passed to the provider as --min-cuda-version so the host driver can actually run this image. null means the runtime imposes no floor and the flag is omitted entirely -- an absent requirement must not become the string 'null' on a command line.
